sa_market_summary: The Kia Sonet is an Indian-built compact SUV with 2,542 used sales in South Africa in 2025 at an average of R299,077 according to AutoTrader. Most cars use a 1.5-litre naturally aspirated petrol with a manual or IVT (CVT) automatic, while upper trims offered a 1.0 T-GDi turbo with a 7-speed DCT; Kia discontinued the turbo in September 2026. It is well equipped with a comfortable ride, but the entry-level LX has only two airbags and scored one star for adult protection in AA/Global NCAP testing, while EX+ and SX models have six airbags.

known_faults.fault: DCT judder and heat in traffic (1.0 T-GDi)
known_faults.mileage_range: Any mileage, worse with heavy stop-start use
known_faults.description: The 7-speed dry-clutch DCT on turbo models can judder when pulling away and overheat in long traffic jams, an issue shared with other Hyundai and Kia models that use this gearbox.
known_faults.what_to_inspect: Test in slow traffic for 15 minutes. Check for juddering from standstill, delayed engagement and any transmission temperature warning.

known_faults.description: A News24 test car had an intermittent brake shudder when braking hard from 120km/h, usually a sign of uneven disc wear. It was reported on one test vehicle rather than as a widespread fault.
known_faults.what_to_inspect: Do a firm stop from highway speed and feel for vibration through the pedal or steering wheel.

known_faults.description: Not a mechanical fault, but the naturally aspirated 1.5 loses roughly 17% of its power at Reef altitude and sounds coarse under hard acceleration. A heavily loaded car can struggle on Highveld hills.
known_faults.what_to_inspect: If you live in Gauteng, test drive with passengers on a hill and at highway speed before committing.

what_to_inspect_before_buying: Check the airbag count: entry LX models have two airbags and scored one star for adult protection
Confirm the service plan: cut from 4-year/60,000km to 3-year/45,000km after the 2024 refresh
On turbo DCT cars, test in slow traffic for judder or temperature warnings
Do a firm stop from 120km/h to check for brake shudder
Verify Kia service history and remaining warranty
Check whether cruise control is fitted, as lower trims lack it
Test-drive the 1.5 at altitude with passengers if you live on the Highveld
owner_sentiment: Positive. Owners like the Sonet's comfortable ride on rough roads, modern features such as wireless Android Auto, and smart styling; one TopAuto owner review called it the happiest they had been with a car. The main criticisms are the weak entry-level safety specification, the 1.5 engine's lack of punch at altitude, missing cruise control on lower trims and the shorter service plan after 2024.
